finalCrossCheck: Major emergency-medicine RCT cross-check remains incomplete because the exact configured PubMed routes were inaccessible and no complete EM-journal count could be established.

General-journal cross-check verified three simultaneous randomized trials of middle meningeal artery embolization for nonacute subdural hematoma and selected all three because their heterogeneous results materially affect interpretation.
EMBOLISE verified online 2024-11-20: adjunctive embolization reduced repeat surgery from 11.3% to 4.1% but had a 2.0% rate of serious embolization-related adverse events, including disabling stroke.
MAGIC-MT verified online 2024-11-20: the primary 90-day recurrence or progression endpoint was not significantly reduced (6.7% vs 9.9%; P=0.10), preventing an overly positive class-level summary.
STEM verified online 2024-11-20 despite a 2025 print issue: its composite 180-day treatment-failure endpoint was 16% versus 36%, with 30-day disabling stroke or death 3% in both groups.

PROTECT-MT verified Epub 2024-11-20: balloon guide catheter use during thrombectomy produced worse 90-day ordinal mRS outcomes than conventional guide catheters and the trial was terminated early for safety concerns.
The already retained BALANCE bloodstream-infection antibiotic-duration trial first online 2024-11-20 remains associated with this window and was not duplicated.

AHA/ASA cross-check identified the systemic complications of acute stroke statement on 2024-11-25, after this window.
